comment: None of these are good. You write "Ordinary heat, real physics, no renderer. A simmering pan shows nothing." What does this mean? A simmering pan doesn't show nothing when I boil water on the stove, I see bubbles form at the bottom, rise to the top and pop, causing surface bubbles. (4) isn't the case we are discussing, I am discussing if lava or another heat source is at the bottom. If I hot rock is thrown in a lake, etc.
